messages.subject: use output as an input to another function
parts: Hi, I have 4 different functions on my shiny app, I want to know if there is a way to use the output of my first function as the imput to my 4 function? because to calculate my 4 function I need the results of the first and the second ones.

messages.author: 68ce5dd269fd758c
messages.subject: Re: use output as an input to another function
parts:
I don't think so. 

Suppose the result of first function was transferred to itself and other 3 function, the first function was be triggered again, so it keeps to transfer data to itself and others, which is a dead loop.
